BOX 41-15  Natural Sleep Remedies 
and Recommended Dosages
 1. Herbal: Use singly or in combination, once a day at HS (see Chapter 12 
for possible interactions).
Valerian (200-800 mg/day)
Passion flower (90-360 mg)
l-Theanine (50-200 mg)
Hops (30-120 mg)
Wild lettuce (18-64 mg)
Lemon Balm Extract (20-80 mg)
These are all combined in a product called the Revitalizing Sleep 
Formula (1-4 capsules at bedtime)
 2. Melatonin: 0.5 - 5 mg at bedtime (0.5 mg is usually optimal for sleep, 
but higher doses may also decrease nighttime acid reflux).
 3. Two to three spritzs or sprays of lavender on the pillow at bedtime 
helps sleep. Lavender is also available in capsule form.
Source: Teitelbaum JE: Effective treatment of chronic fatigue 
syndrome, Integrative Medicine 10:44, 2012.
